_: THREE STAGES. a reads the clip, b re-scans a's tape perpendicular, c re-scans b's and melts it. THE RULE THAT MAKES A DEEP CHAIN WORK, and it took three wrong attempts to find: SIZE EACH advance TO THE TIME THAT STAGE ACTUALLY HAS. advance = wraps * 960 / (60 * seconds_available), and about 1.5 wraps reads as one coherent sweep. A downstream stage that starts at 6s in a 20s run has 14 seconds, not 20 — give it the advance for 20 and it never completes a pass, which is what starves it. WHAT DOES NOT WORK: advance 0 on anything but the first stage (it fits the sweep to the WHOLE run, so a late start can never finish one), and a very high advance anywhere (head.position ramps across the full scan, so a racing write with a barely-moving head just repeats one strip of the bed). startAt lets each source get ahead — the diagonal edges you see are the CAUSAL FRONTIER, a stage cannot record what its source has not written yet, and at this depth they read as deliberate structure rather than damage. Wants a CONTINUOUS source: cuts compound through three passes into noise.
